page: Amazon Web Services d3en.12xlarge is a dense storage-optimized virtual machine built on the AWS Nitro System. It is powered by a custom Intel Xeon 8259CL x86_64 processor clocked at 3.1 GHz, delivering 24 physical cores and 48 virtual CPUs via symmetric multithreading. Memory resources total 192.0 GB of DDR4 operating at 3 GHz, maintaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU distribution. The platform integrates 335,520 GB of local HDD capacity alongside a baseline network throughput of 75 Gbps, with zero integrated GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations place single-threaded compute efficiency in the lower performance quartile, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1,143.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 23.51 GB/sec. In contrast, aggregate multithreaded capacity scores reliably within average tiers, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 34,592.44, a Geekbench multi-core score of 10,414.0, and 40,652.97 in stress-ng multi-core testing. Memory bandwidth shows solid throughput, measuring 108.27 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 48.07 GB/sec for large block writes.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance balances dense, high-volume spindle storage with expansive network throughput. While its local HDD topology is less suited for random-access, latency-sensitive database IOPS compared to NVMe SSD arrays, it offers massive capacity per deployed node. Cost efficiency is driven primarily by storage density and sequential data transfers across its 75 Gbps interface, making the instance optimal for massive data lakes, big data processing frameworks like Hadoop, sequential log analytics, and archival storage pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services d3en.12xlarge is a storage-optimized instance running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, powered by a 24-core, 48-vCPU Intel Xeon 8259CL processor at 3.1 GHz. It features 192.0 GB of DDR4 RAM, a high-bandwidth 75 Gbps baseline network interface, and 335,520 GB of dense local HDD capacity without hardware GPU acceleration. Benchmark profiles indicate mid-tier multithreaded compute (PassMark CPU score 34,592.44 and stress-ng multi-core 40,652.97) balanced against modest single-thread metrics (Geekbench single-core 1,143.0). With extensive HDD storage capacity and sustained memory bandwidth (108.27 GB/sec uncached reads), the d3en.12xlarge is architected for large-scale sequential data systems, big data analytics, log aggregation clusters, and data lake workloads requiring substantial local volume.
